name: The Constitutional Walking Tour
highlight: A 75-minute stroll past 20+ historic sites, from Independence Hall to the Liberty Bell.
description: The city's classic history walk covers more than 20 landmarks across Independence National Historical Park with knowledgeable guides. It's the easiest way to take in founding-era Philadelphia on foot, and a great orientation on a first day in town.

name: Grim Philly
highlight: History-degree guides mix true crime, scandal and hauntings on nationally ranked night tours.
description: Led by guides with graduate history degrees, Grim Philly blends documented true crime, colonial scandal and ghost lore into an adults-oriented evening walk. Vampire, ghost, and history-and-hauntings routes are all on offer.

name: Ghost Tour of Philadelphia
highlight: A candlelit walk through haunted Old City, running nightly for over 30 years.
description: One of the longest-running ghost walks in the country winds through Society Hill and Old City sharing the region's spookiest true tales by candlelight. It departs most evenings from Signers' Garden near Independence Hall.

name: City Food Tours
highlight: Philly's original food tour, from Reading Terminal Market to Old City tasting stops.
description: The city's original culinary walking tour pairs generous tastings with neighborhood history, whether you choose the Reading Terminal Market route or a Center City progressive lunch. A local favorite that's collected awards for years.

name: Tiny Table Tours
highlight: Intimate small-group food tours led by restaurant pros through the historic Italian Market.
description: Small-group tastings guided by hospitality veterans through South 9th Street's historic Italian Market, with stops for cheese, cannoli, roast pork and more. Groups stay small, so it feels like eating with a friend who knows everyone.

name: Mural Arts Philadelphia
highlight: The official guides to the world's largest outdoor art gallery.
description: Philadelphia has more public murals than any other U.S. city, and Mural Arts is the nonprofit behind them. Their expert-led walking and private tours are the definitive way to see the work up close and hear the stories behind it.

name: City Brew Tours Philadelphia
highlight: An all-inclusive, chauffeured crawl to local breweries with tastings and food pairings.
description: A hassle-free way to sample Philadelphia's craft-beer scene: transportation, a dozen-plus pours across several breweries, a behind-the-scenes brewing look, and food pairings are all included. Public and private trips run year-round.

name: Big Bus Philadelphia
highlight: Open-top double-decker with hop-on, hop-off access to 25+ stops citywide.
description: The open-top double-decker loops the city's major landmarks with live guides and hop-on, hop-off flexibility, so you can ride the full circuit or jump off wherever you like. One- and multi-day passes make it an easy first-day orientation.

name: Philadelphia Trolley Works
highlight: Old-fashioned trolley and double-decker loops, plus festive seasonal holiday-light tours.
description: Narrated trolley and bus loops through historic Philadelphia from a long-running local operator, with hop-on, hop-off stops at the big sights. Their seasonal Holiday Lights tours are a December favorite.

name: Philly Bike Tour Co.
highlight: Guided small-group rides linking Independence Hall, murals and the Schuylkill riverfront.
description: Easygoing, small-group rides cover far more ground than a walking tour, connecting Old City landmarks, mural-lined streets and the Schuylkill River Trail. Bikes, helmets and local storytelling are included.

name: Philly by Segway
highlight: Glide past historic landmarks and along the riverfront on easy, fully-trained Segway tours.
description: After a quick training session you'll cruise past Independence Mall, the Parkway museums and Penn's Landing with almost no effort. It's a fun, ground-covering option for first-time visitors who'd rather roll than walk.

name: Spirit of Philadelphia
highlight: A multi-deck yacht on the Delaware with buffet dining, dancing and skyline views.
description: Lunch, dinner and party cruises sail the Delaware from Penn's Landing aboard a climate-controlled yacht, with meals, music and open-air decks for taking in the skyline. A relaxed way to see the city from the water.

name: Association of Philadelphia Tour Guides
highlight: Certified, licensed local guides available for custom private and step-on tours.
description: If you'd rather have a tour built around your own interests, this association connects visitors with the city's certified, licensed guides for private walks, group step-on tours and specialty themes. Ideal for families, clubs and corporate groups.

name: Eastern State Penitentiary
highlight: Guide-led tours through the haunting ruins of the world's first true penitentiary.
description: Once the most famous and expensive prison in the world, Eastern State is now a preserved ruin you can explore by audio tour or guided program, including Al Capone's restored cell. Each fall it becomes one of the country's best haunted attractions.
